# Term Parer Requirements
The term paper for CIV-E-665 consists of three main components:

• Project Proposal:  
• 1-2 page document  
• Background and brief description of the methods (Problem Geometry, Boundary and Loading conditions, Type of Analysis)  

• Project Report:  
    • Topic of interest on ABAQUS  

• Recorded Presentation:  • 4-8 mins Screen recording (Only Voice Over) project summary
